overview: This table sets the score and point ranges that decide your rank, match grade, story relationship level, and mission tier.
description: Shared, unsharded lookup vocabulary of named numeric intervals. Each row's inclusive float [Min, Max] band is resolved by Id; reconstructed C++ consumers use it to classify battle result scores, rank points, PvE risk/point values and character relationship values, and to supply rank-tier bounds to UI and shop-unlock checks. The table has no behavior of its own.

Id.simple: This name tells the game which rank, mission, match result, or story relationship the range belongs to.
Id.technical: FName UPROPERTY (BlueprintReadWrite, EditAnywhere; AllowPrivateAccess=true), exported as ID; ImportKeyField is Id and the constructor leaves it NAME_None because only Min/Max are set. All 104 exported rows carry an ID equal to their row name, with no duplicates. WidgetTest_FindGlobalThreshold (retail 0x12face0) and local inline equivalents scan GlobalThresholdDataTables (DTM+0x300) in table order and return the first FindRow hit with missing-row warnings suppressed; every observed shared-helper call passes bCheckNone=false/bUnused=false and the inline finders have no game-level None check. Actual foreign keys exist only in RankPointDataTable.Id_GlobalThreshold (27 rows), PvEAllyParameterDataTable.Id_GlobalThreshold (5), PvEMissionLotteryDataTable.Id_GlobalThreshold (223 rows / 15 distinct keys) and PvEExtraMissionLotteryDataTable.Id_GlobalThreshold (14); all exported foreign keys resolve. Other keys are hard-coded names in C++. MissionCharacter, PvEGrowth, StoryCharaRelateLevel and StoryCharaRelateChange rows do not store a threshold key.

Min.simple: The lowest score or point total that still counts. Raising it makes that rank or level harder to reach.
Min.technical: float UPROPERTY (BlueprintReadWrite, EditAnywhere; AllowPrivateAccess=true) with constructor default 0.0f; all 104 exported rows set it. Classification callers cast the int32 input to float and use UKismetMathLibrary::InRange_FloatFloat(Value, Min, Max, true, true): battle result rank, rank-tier lookup, PvE AI level, ally parameter, risk mission class, mission lottery, extra-mission point level and extra-mission lottery. Min is also the tier floor for story relation level/value conversion, rank sorting by ascending Min, grade/result progress bars and remaining points, leaderboard-card RankPoint (FMath::RoundToInt) and the shop PvPRankPointMax unlock (FMath::CeilToInt(Min)). Exported story relation floors are 0/25/50/75/100; extra-mission point levels 1..11 use 0/10/.../100; rank points span 0..99999, matching the save clamp in AddRankPoint.

Max.simple: The largest score or point total that still counts. Raising it lets more results count.
Max.technical: float UPROPERTY (BlueprintReadWrite, EditAnywhere; AllowPrivateAccess=true) with constructor default 0.0f; all 104 exported rows set it. Every range-classification caller uses bIncludeMaximum=true; no exclusive-max consumer was found. SetupGradeInfo formats Max as the displayed rank upper point value. Story relation conversion and the shop unlock never read Max. Exported maxima include 24/49/74/99/100 for relation levels, 99999 for rank-point/ally/AI bands, 50000 for the top PvE mission bands, 9999999 for result-score catch-alls, exact singletons at 100/200, and -1..-1 sentinel bands for PVE_AI_LEVEL_01/02/10; those sentinels cannot contain ordinary nonnegative risk values and have no special-case branch in the consumer.

notes: Load/cache path: StartInitialLoading creates a DataTable-type primary asset loader named GlobalThresholdDataTable; Tick waits for all loaders, resolves that loader through GetPrimaryAssetObject<UDataTable> and appends the non-null object to the single GlobalThresholdDataTables array at DTM+0x300. StoryDataTables() and GetTables() are local aliases for the same GameInstance manager. All threshold finders scan tables in order and return the first row hit; no global duplicate/overlap validation exists.

Export coverage: one unsharded, unlocalized table named GlobalThresholdDataTable, RowStruct Class'GameDataTableRow_GlobalThreshold' in /Script/AbramsDataTable. It has 104 unique row keys and every row has exactly ID, Min and Max; this matches the catalog's 104-row count.

Row families: 5 story relation floors, 27 contiguous rank-point bands, 16 mode-specific result-score bands (4 modes x C/B/A/S), 16 PvE mission bands, 11 extra-mission point bands, 14 extra-mission lottery bands, 10 PvE AI-level bands and 5 PvE ally-parameter bands. Inputs are integer point/risk/score values cast to float; only some consumers convert the result to a 1-based level/index.

Data relationships: only RankPointDataTable (27 unique keys), PvEAllyParameterDataTable (5), PvEMissionLotteryDataTable (223 rows to 15 keys) and PvEExtraMissionLotteryDataTable (14) carry Id_GlobalThreshold, and every exported key resolves. PvEGrowth uses its own ExperienceThreshold; MissionCharacter has AILevel but no threshold foreign key. Story relationship values come from StoryCharaRelateChange deltas plus StoryCharaGraphPair start levels and are converted using hard-coded STORY_CHARA_RELATE_LV_1..5 Min floors.

Precedence: rank lookup keeps the first RankPoint row as a fallback and returns the first inclusive band match; battle-score lookup tests fixed C/B/A/S name arrays and maps them to ranks 1..4 with default 1; extra-mission point and AI-level lookups iterate ordered hard-coded name arrays and return Index+1, with extra missions forcing AI level >=6. PVE_MISSION_X_0_99999 overlaps every A..E mission band inside a TMap whose iteration order is not fixed by source order, so which mapping wins cannot be established from these exports alone.

Sentinels and caps: PVE_AI_LEVEL_01/02/10 are -1..-1 and never match normal nonnegative risk in code that has no sentinel branch. Exact singleton rows end the 100-point extra-mission and relation scales and the 200-point TAG lottery scale. Rank points clamp to 0..99999 and PvE risk to 0..50000, matching the top exported bands; result-score catch-alls use 9999999.

Consumer-specific interpretation: story relation level/value use only Min floors (clamping level 1..5 for value lookup); the shop compares the saved PvPRankPointMax record with ceil(Min), not Max; grade UI displays Min/Max and computes progress from previous/current/next Min with 'next' limited to the same RankPointClass; result-change UI uses current/next Min without a zero-difference guard; leaderboard cards use RoundToInt(Min) or 0 past the row list.

Evidence boundary: all behavioral statements here come from reconstructed C++ plus the JSON export. The reconstruction's AGENTS.md/FACTS.md states that retail Blueprints contain no logic; no retail Blueprint bytecode was inspected in this review, so no Blueprint-only consumer is claimed.

usages.detail: StartInitialLoading registers the GlobalThresholdDataTable primary asset loader; Tick at line 178 resolves and caches it in GlobalThresholdDataTables (DTM+0x300).
WidgetTest_FindGlobalThreshold (0x12face0) scans the loaded tables for the first row hit; all observed calls pass bCheckNone=false and bUnused=false.
GetResultScoreRank tests the score against mode-specific RESULT_SCORE[_STORY|_PVE|_ARCADE]_C/B/A/S inclusive bands in fixed order, mapping to result ranks 1..4, default 1.
GameRankPoint_FindRow uses RankPoint.Id_GlobalThreshold and inclusive Min/Max, keeping the first RankPoint row as fallback; lobby, online, replay and other UI callers go through this helper.
Extra-mission point level loops PVE_EXTRA_MISSION_POINT_01..11 inclusively and returns Index+1 (0 on no match); the suggestion widget forces 100 for extra missions.
AI level loops PVE_AI_LEVEL_01..10 inclusively and returns Index+1; MissionId containing PVE_EXTRA_MISSION forces at least 6.
Ally parameter selection resolves PvEAllyParameter.Id_GlobalThreshold and tests risk in the inclusive band; no match yields no ally multiplier row.
Risk mission class maps hard-coded PVE_MISSION_* keys to uint8 classes via a TMap and inclusive ranges; the overlapping X catch-all's precedence is not source-order fixed.
Mission lottery filters PvEMissionLottery rows backwards by threshold FK and inclusive risk band, then weighted-picks the surviving rows.
Story relation level and value helpers use only the Min floors of the five STORY_CHARA_RELATE_LV_* rows; indirect callers include GetCharaRelateLevel and the relation detail gauge.
Grade UI sorts rank rows by threshold Min, formats Min/Max and computes progress from previous/current/next Mins, with next restricted to the same RankPointClass.
Result rank-change UI sorts by Min for the next row and uses current/next Min at lines 170-175 for progress and remaining points; no next row gives a full bar.
Leaderboard-card unpacking reads RankIndex from the packed card, returns RoundToInt(Min) for that RankPoint row, or 0 past the end.
PvPRankPointMax unlock resolves ShopLineup ValueStrs[0] to a RankPoint row, then its threshold, and compares the saved record with ceil(Min).
PvE extra-mission lottery selects SOLO/TAG rows by point count and tests the summed points against the inclusive band before a probability roll; this is a PvE consumer despite the file name.
Indirect consumer: the rank manual builds grade widgets through SetupGradeInfo, which resolves threshold rows for the selected RankPointClass.
Indirect consumer: sets the extra-mission suggestion animation level from GamePvE_GetExtraMissionPointLevel.
